title: Can Language Models See the Circuit in Pixelated RFIC Passives?
abstract: arXiv:2611.27559v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The emergence of inverse-designed, pixelated passives for microwave and millimeter-wave applications has been a major development in the field of RFIC design. These devices, which appear to be QR-code-like in structure, exist in a generalizable, high-dimensional design space that includes conventional passive topologies. However, these structures are naturally unintuitive for designers, and failures or deviations in performance are difficult to debug. In this work, we ask whether a frontier language model can understand, predict, and edit the responses and layout structure of pixelated passives. The agent, run with all tools disabled, is first asked to read layouts on 18x18 and 27x27 tile grids and, in a single reply, predict the input impedance and loss of the structure from 20-100 GHz. translated_title: 语言模型能“看懂”像素化射频集成电路无源器件中的电路吗？
translated_abstract: 面向微波和毫米波应用的逆设计像素化无源器件的出现，是射频集成电路设计领域的一项重大进展。这类器件在结构上形似二维码，存在于一个可泛化的高维设计空间中，该空间也涵盖了传统无源拓扑结构。然而，这些结构对设计者而言天然缺乏直观性，其性能失效或偏差也难以调试。在这项工作中，我们探究前沿语言模型能否理解、预测并编辑像素化无源器件的响应与版图结构。该智能体在禁用所有工具的条件下运行，首先被要求读取18×18和27×27瓦片网格上的版图，并在单次回复中预测该结构在20–100 GHz范围内的输入阻抗与损耗。在八个遗传算法合成版图和五个随机填充版图上，预测的史密斯圆图轨迹与全波仿真结果高度吻合，并呈现出系统性的……
tldr: 本研究首次验证了前沿大语言模型在完全禁用工具的情况下，能够仅凭读取18×18和27×27网格版图，就准确预测像素化射频无源器件在20–100 GHz的输入阻抗与损耗，表明语言模型可以“看懂”这类反直觉的逆设计电路结构。
en_tdlr: This work demonstrates that a frontier language model, with all tools disabled, can accurately predict the 20–100 GHz input impedance and loss of pixelated RFIC passives solely from 18×18 and 27×27 layout grids, showing that LLMs can "see" the circuit within these unintuitive inverse-designed structures.
